rejected_claims.reason: The supplied evidence supports only that passing `path` or `argv` skips auto-detect entirely (bun.com/docs/runtime/webview.md). Neither teacher run documents that `path`/`argv` cannot be combined with `url: "ws://..."` — that mutual-exclusivity constraint is invented. The claim also grades on it via the required pattern `cannot be combined|can't be combined`, so the unsupported portion is load-bearing for lexical grading.
